Design effect for a cluster randomised trial (Machin Eq 12.5 / 12.7)

Source: R/calc-complex.R
cluster_size_inflation.Rd

With a constant cluster size m this is Machin et al. (2018) Eq 12.5, DE = 1 + (m - 1) * rho. Supplying cv_m (the coefficient of variation of cluster size) switches to Eq 12.7, which allows for variable cluster sizes before the number of clusters is known:

Usage

cluster_size_inflation(cluster_size, icc, cv_m = NULL)

Arguments

cluster_size

Number of subjects per cluster (mbar if sizes vary).

icc

Intra-cluster correlation rho; in [0, 1).

cv_m

Optional coefficient of variation of cluster size (Eq 12.7); non-negative. NULL (default) gives the constant-size Eq 12.5.

Value

The design effect (numeric scalar >= 1).

Details


  DE = 1 + [(CV(m)^2 + 1) * mbar - 1] * rho

Examples

SampleSizeCalc:::cluster_size_inflation(20, 0.05) # 1.95 (Eq 12.5)
#> [1] 1.95
SampleSizeCalc:::cluster_size_inflation(20, 0.05, cv_m = 0.35) # Eq 12.7
#> [1] 2.0725
